integrity: The result is supported by an analytic proof using interval coloring, conditional Hoeffding's lemma, generalized Hölder, and Chernoff optimization.
No numerical experiment is used as proof of the universal statement.
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires an increasing two-sided filtration, adapted variables bounded by one, and deterministic prespecified positive integer horizons.
The overlap bound is sufficient and is not claimed to be sharp for every horizon pattern.
Random or data-adaptive horizons and unbounded variables are not covered.
title: Overlap-sensitive concentration for nonuniform prediction horizons
